messages:
Mira (Support): FYI tenant ledgerpay-prod on Dedicated reported repeated 429s and p50 latency jumps this morning. Customer says 'sudden throttling' during long-context conversations. I pulled recent infra logs, looks like KV cache eviction spikes around 08:42 UTC. Anyone oncall?

Alex (SRE): I'm on. Can you paste tenant id + last deploy?

Mira (Support): tenant: ledgerpay-prod, last deploy: 2026-02-14 02:10 UTC (model pin v3.1.2). Quick tail of runtime logs:
``` 
[08:42:11] kvcache: total=12.1GB used=10.9GB free=1.2GB slabs=128 frag_ratio=0.72 evict_count=452 throttle=true reclaim=120MB
[08:42:15] request: tenant=ledgerpay-prod id=abcd1234 tokens=29120 seq_len=30720 result=429
```
Customer load pattern: lots of long context chats (~30k tokens) and occasional short queries.

Tara (ML Eng): High frag_ratio + large seq_len points to slab fragmentation from long ctxs. Those 30k token sessions allocate many KV pages and then leave holes when sessions finish -> lots of small free fragments. Our slab allocator doesn't coalesce well.

Omar (Eng Ops): Repro steps that matched our lab earlier: run loadgen with heavy longctx and small interleaved spikes. Example command:
```
./tools/loadgen --tenant ledgerpay-prod --mode longctx --ctx 30000 --qps 8 --duration 12m
```
Or curl example:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://dedicated.redwood.example/v1/generate" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Tenant: ledgerpay-prod" \
 -d '{"input":"<30k token convo...>", "max_tokens":0}'
```
When run we hit kvcache_eviction_rate > 200/s and autoscaler didn't react until reclaim dropped available mem under 600MB.

Alex (SRE): Noted. Autoscaler TTL + conservative scale-up threshold means we get stuck until OOM-like pressure. We saw similar issue where fragmentation prevented effective allocation even though node had free memory.

Mira (Support): Customer is asking for mitigation now. They want a timeline.

Jen (Solutions): Short-term options: enable burst capacity for ledgerpay-prod (can spin up 2x nodes for 30m), or lower tenant max_context_size to 16k for a canary rollout. Which should we propose?

Alex (SRE): Immediate: enable burst and set tenant policy to limit max_context_size to 16k (failsafe). Medium: deploy slab coalescing patch (ENG-9872) + kvcache_reclaim_aggressiveness tweak. Long: allocator redesign.

Tara (ML Eng): Also recommend enabling prefix caching for these long sessions so we avoid putting huge KV for same prefixes. Will add a prompt-level client-side suggestion.

ops-bot: alert: kvcache_eviction_rate_high ledgerpay-prod (08:42 UTC) — paging SRE.

Omar (Eng Ops): Repro artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/ledgerpay/2026-02-14/kvcache-dump-08-42.tar.gz

Alex (SRE): Action items:
- [ ] Enable burst capacity now (ops) — Omar
- [ ] Apply tenant max_context_size=16384 policy (support+ops) — Mira/Omar
- [ ] Run lab repro with loadgen and record fragmentation metrics (SRE/Tara) — Alex/Tara
- [ ] Schedule ENG-9872 rollout (allocator coalesce) and add canary (Eng) — Tara
- [ ] Communicate ETA to customer and offer temporary compensation/credits (Solutions) — Jen

Mira (Support): I'll message LedgerPay and offer the 30m burst + rollback plan. Will update once customer confirms.

Alex (SRE): I'll watch metrics and keep thread updated. If eviction rate doesn't subside within 10m after burst, we'll escalate infra on-call.

Jen (Solutions): Thanks team :thumbsup: 

Mira (Support): customer replied: accepts burst. confirms they're ok with temporary max_context cap. will monitor.

Alex (SRE): last check at 08:52: eviction_rate down to 18/s, frag_ratio 0.58, p50 back to baseline. Closing for now but keeping follow-up on ENG-9872. :white_check_mark:
